iterations.critique: Only sparse violet dust arcs render — the persistent ring is missing. Root cause from the report: 0005 (live psec twin) REJECTS setExpression on both instances (it accepts setValue — new twin fact), so the ring instance runs on the 0146 expression alone, which on an animated emitter yields near-zero effective emission (the r10 light-path rule). The few larger dots along the arc are the ring instance at starvation density. Dust instance and Glow render fine; instance indexing works.

Frames identical to iter1 — the rescue failed and produced a mechanism finding: 0005's writability is STATEFUL. It rejects setValue once the emitter position carries an expression (this comp acquired the sweep in iter1), which is why e09/e10 worked (runner order: params land before expressions on a fresh comp) and this loop cannot recover (0146 alone starves on an animated emitter regardless of value). The fix is plan-level — set both psec homes as PARAMS before any position expression, i.e. a re-plan on a fresh comp, outside the nudge vocabulary. No applicable suggestions.
